title: Troops battle event not running whenever the battle is victorious

posts.author: Cross-Cut513
posts.body:
(sorry, english is not my main)
I'm pretty new to the whole "making game" programming stuff. Saw RPG Maker VX Ace free on steam and decided to try it on my free time.
In town map. i have an character that can give the player list of quest to do. For now focus on the "slay 10 slimes in the fields" quest
In the field map, i set the slime that spawn randomly only in region 1. I put a text message that shows progress of how many slimes has been defeated every time the slime is hit 0 hp.
The first slime that got defeated, the text message shows properly, and the counter (control variables) goes up. But the second one do not. It likely got interrupted by the victory battle message after all enemy is been defeated.
I tried to add one more slime and third event page to see if the second event page is running properly or not (it does work, but the third one once again did not). I might be failed to understand something here, if there anyone that can help me with this? appreciate it

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
That's how it works. You can try to make it work with immortal states on enemies and additional troop events, or download a script:
End Phase Triggers
This script extends the troop event system with "end phase triggers". This is simply a final check on all of the event pages when a victory/lose condition has been met. Any pages that can be run durin
himeworks.com
